Software handling user data must default to 100% in-browser processing via WebAssembly, Web Workers, or Canvas APIs.

DOM-H-C4EF28D3.title: Domain H — Technical Construction: Zero-Latency Client-Side Canvas & WebAssembly Ingestion
DOM-H-C4EF28D3.content: Client-side file transformation pipelines must ingest files via Blob.arrayBuffer(), parse MIME-types strictly in memory, and transcode using OffscreenCanvas or WebAssembly workers without freezing the main UI thread. All allocations must be revoked via URL.revokeObjectURL().
DOM-H-C4EF28D3.summary: Client-side file transformation pipelines must ingest files via Blob.arrayBuffer(), parse MIME-types strictly in memory, and transcode using OffscreenCanvas or WebAssembly workers without freezing the main UI thread. DOM-J-C14FC2D6.title: Domain J — Search & Distribution: Self-Referential Canonical and JSON-LD Structured Data Hierarchy
DOM-J-C14FC2D6.content: Every indexable page must emit a self-referential canonical URL tag, OpenGraph image/title metadata, and a Schema.org WebApplication / SoftwareApplication JSON-LD script block before closing </head> to guarantee maximum search discoverability and zero-indexation duplication.

DOM-K-353B93D6.title: Domain K — Quality & Verification: Zero-Outbound Network Probe & Assertion Barrier
DOM-K-353B93D6.content: Verification suites for client-side privacy tools must execute live network inspection probes during transformation workflows. Any outgoing HTTP POST, PUT, or WebSocket connection emitted during file processing constitutes an automatic fatal verification failure.

DOM-L-1B851132.title: Domain L — Deployment & Operations: Chunked Multi-Part Vault Backup & 1-Click Recovery
DOM-L-1B851132.content: Disaster recovery snapshots must atomically chunk repositories into 45MB parts to strictly comply with GitHub 100MB blob limits, encrypt credentials with AES-256-GCM, and verify 100% SHA-256 manifest parity prior to state restore.
